page.overview:
Who is Antasma X?

Antasma X is the stronger counterpart of Antasma. Antasma X appears as a boss in the Battle Ring in Mario & Luigi: Dream Team.

Antasma X looks likes his normal counterpart, only with a blue cloak and skin, and bright blue eyes. In bat form, he has gold skin and wings, and pink eyes.

Antasma X's abilities are equivalent to Antasma, but stronger.

Antasma X appears as a boss in the Battle Ring. His attacks remain the same, but he is stronger than his normal counterpart, Antasma.
